<h1 align="center">Castaway</h1>

<p align="center">
  <b>推 lowbun: ten hours on one tiny island. she idles. every so often, on the next bar, something happens.</b><br>
  <sub>working title &middot; a stationary-frame lo-fi video for YouTube &middot; 16:9, 1080p, 30 fps &middot; always daytime<br>an unofficial remake inspired by the 1992 screensaver <i>Johnny Castaway</i>, not affiliated with it or its owners</sub>
</p>

**Castaway** is a ten-hour lo-fi video in which almost nothing happens, on purpose. One young woman, one tiny island, one tall palm, a raft and a great deal of time. She idles, nodding along to her headphones. Every so often something happens, and the island leaves a comment under the post: a ship sails past nine times without being noticed, a stray cat arrives by crate and claims the top of the palm, the tide boos the sandcastle off the beach, a coconut lands on a hermit crab and becomes its new shell. She never replies. She nods.

Every timestamp in that comment column is real. They are events from the default run (seed 1992), read out of the schedule's own simulation, with the video starting at 08:00. The ship really does turn up nine seconds after she opens a coconut. That one is in the schedule on purpose.

**More than 90 activities** live in [activities.toml](activities.toml) (94 on 2026-10-01), on four timers: every 2 to 5 minutes, every 12 to 25, every 30 to 60, and every 3 to 6 hours for the super rare ones. Every start snaps to the next bar of the music, every 3 seconds, so the gags land on the beat. **Every sound is synthesized from code** by [tools/make_audio.py](tools/make_audio.py): no samples, no loops, no recordings.

```sh
python tools/serve.py
# then open http://127.0.0.1:8765/
```

That is the renderer: a web page with a live preview of the island and an export to a YouTube-ready MP4, encoded frame-exact in the browser. Plain ES modules, no build step, no npm packages. No video has been published yet, so the board is the only place to read about it.

<details>
<summary><b>看板列表</b>, the board list: Castaway by the numbers, where popularity is an honest count</summary>

<br>

<p align="center">
  <img src="assets/91-ptt-telnet-board_opus_5.5-boards.svg" width="100%" alt="The board list of the 一棵椰子樹 station, 80 columns. A blue title bar, key hints, a grey column header (number, board, class, description, popularity, moderator), then twenty boards, each a part of Castaway, with a white cursor dot stepping down one board per bar. Popularity is a real count for one default ten-hour run: Castaway 1 (she is the only one there), Idle shown as a blue explode mark (about 8640 bars of nodding), Regular HOT, Occasional 30 and Rare 13 in yellow, SuperRare 2, Chained 20, Activities 94 in red, Ships 9, Coconuts 29, Sandcastle 10 (the tide wins 10-0), Cat 5, Signal 1, Theme HOT (600 loops), Bars 12000 as a cyan explode mark, Beats 48000 green, Synth HOT, Samples empty, Frames 1080000 magenta, Night empty. The status bar reads 10/1 Thursday 8:00, 每天都是晴天 (every day is a sunny day), 1 user online, I am lowbun, pager on, (h) help.">
</p>

On the real thing, a board's popularity is how many people are reading it right now, and the number changes colour as it climbs: plain up to 10, bright yellow to 50, bright red to 99, a white **HOT** from 100, then the character 爆 (*bào*, "explode") with an exclamation mark, recoloured at 1,000, 2,000, 5,000, 10,000, 30,000, 60,000 and 100,000. Here every board is a piece of Castaway and its popularity is how many of that thing one default 10-hour run contains. The ladder is used honestly: Frames earns the top colour because ten hours at 30 fps is 1,080,000 of them. Castaway itself has a popularity of 1. Night has none.

| board | count in one default run | why |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Castaway | 1 | one person on the island |
| Regular / Occasional / Rare / SuperRare | ~155 / ~30 / ~13 / ~2 | medians of 200 simulated runs; super rare is capped at 3 |
| Chained | ~20 | follow-ups, like the reply bottle |
| Ships | 9 | passes in seed 1992, all while she was busy |
| Coconuts | 29 | sips in seed 1992 |
| Sandcastle | 10 | built 10 times, taken by the tide 10 times |
| Cat | 5 | visits in seed 1992, 1:49:40 on the island in total |
| Theme / Bars / Beats | 600 / 12,000 / 48,000 | a 60-second loop, 3-second bars, 80 BPM, for ten hours |
| Idle | about 8,640 bars | she idles 72% of the default run |
| Synth / Samples | HOT / none | more than 150 sound files, all made from code |

</details>

<details>
<summary><b>推文</b>, the comment column: all twelve, and where each time comes from</summary>

<br>

推 is a push (thumbs up), 噓 a boo, → a plain reply. On the board, the ID is bright yellow, the comment olive, and the date sits at the right edge, and a comment can be no longer than the line allows: 78 columns, minus the mark, the ID and the date. These do the same arithmetic. Times are clock times with the video starting at 08:00, so 0:24:18 into the run is 08:24.

| | ID | comment | time | the default run (seed 1992) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 推 | NotStopping | pass 1 of 9. she was sipping a coconut. | 08:24 | ship at 0:24:18; she opened a coconut at 0:24:09 |
| 推 | PalmTopCat | came in on a crate. the top of the palm is mine. | 08:44 | the cat's first visit, 0:44:06 |
| 噓 | TheTide | that sandcastle was in my lane. | 09:07 | the tide takes the first sandcastle, 1:07:57 |
| → | lowbun | (nods) | 09:12 | idling between a stroll and a coconut |
| 推 | NotStopping | pass 3 of 9. coconut again. she did not look up. | 09:44 | ship at 1:44:30, during the coconut she opened at 1:44:06 |
| 噓 | BackToSender | thrown out to sea. washed straight back. | 11:04 | message in a bottle, 3:04:15 |
| 推 | ShellSuit | a coconut landed on me. it is my shell now. bye. | 11:36 | the coconut and the hermit crab, 3:36:03 |
| 推 | HornSection | she waved! we honked back! we sailed on. | 13:14 | the almost-rescue, 5:14:06 (super rare) |
| → | lowbun | (shrugs, puts the music back on) | 13:16 | the almost-rescue ends, 5:16:00 |
| 推 | AmberBottle | a reply, three hours later. she smiled. | 14:05 | the reply bottle, 6:05:06 (chained) |
| → | lowbun | one bar of signal. top of the palm. worth it. | 14:07 | the signal hunt, 6:07:24 |
| 推 | NotStopping | pass 9 of 9. sandcastle this time. nope. | 17:05 | ship at 9:05:27, during the sandcastle she started at 9:04:30 |

The column loops, like the video does. Also on the island but not in this run's comments: a delivery drone whose parcel is another pair of headphones, a sea turtle, a shark in headphones who nods to the beat, a tour boat of selfie-takers, a bro on an electric hydrofoil who throws a shaka and carves off, bushcraft (fire by friction, a hammock, a lookout up the palm, spear fishing), a kumara she plants that grows over the video, and once in a while she walks out over the water and comes back with an iced coffee. She could leave any time.

</details>

<details>
<summary><b>排程</b>, the schedule: four timers, starts snapped to the bar</summary>

<br>

| tier | every | in a typical 10-hour run |
| --- | --- | --- |
| regular | 2 to 5 minutes | about 155 |
| occasional | 12 to 25 minutes | about 30 |
| rare | 30 to 60 minutes | about 13 |
| super rare | 3 to 6 hours, at most 3 a run | about 2 |
| chained | only after another activity | follow-ups |

Typical counts are the medians of 200 simulated runs, as the file's own header says. She is busy about a third of the time and idling the rest. Lanes let things overlap, so the sea can be busy with a ship while she is busy with a coconut, and the ship even waits up to ten minutes for her to get busy. Every start snaps to the next bar of the music (3 seconds). The default run is 10:00:00 on seed 1992, and the same seed always gives the same ten hours.

Scene life runs alongside: 26 entries, 4 always on and 22 timed. Shore waves and drifting cloud shadows are built; distant birds, planes with vapour trails, whale pods, dolphins, sailboats, sandpipers, a gecko and a rain shower are planned.

```sh
python tools/schedule.py           # validate, and simulate a 10-hour run
python tools/render_demo.py --dev  # dev reel: every activity, with a HUD
```

</details>

<details>
<summary><b>音樂</b>, the sound: all of it made from code, none of it heard yet</summary>

<br>

[tools/make_audio.py](tools/make_audio.py) synthesizes every sound in the project, more than 150 files so far: no samples, no loops, no recordings, so no third-party licence applies. The theme is a seamless 60-second loop at 80 BPM in F major (ii-V-I-vi), 20 bars of exactly 3 seconds, with electric piano, a kalimba lead, soft drums and vinyl crackle. The ocean ambience is a seamless 60-second loop too. The mix sits at -14 LUFS with true peak at or below -1 dBTP, and levels are adjustable in master and per routine.

Nobody has listened to any of it yet. The board will report back.

</details>

<details>
<summary><b>About this header</b>: what the screens are, and what the Chinese says</summary>

<br>

The banner is an article on a Taiwanese telnet bulletin board of the MapleBBS family, the kind people have read through terminal clients since the mid-1990s: 80 columns, every Chinese character two columns wide, the author / title / time header in blue and grey, a cyan rule, and under the post a column of one-line comments, each opening with a push, a boo or an arrow. The picture is drawn the way users drew theirs, out of double-width block characters: eighth bars and four corner triangles, each cell with one foreground and one background colour, and backgrounds limited to the eight darker colours. That limit decides the art (the sea can only brighten towards you, never away). The second screen is the board list, with its colour-coded popularity column and the coloured status bar.

Nothing here uses a system font. The half-width letters are a thin 8x16 bitmap face and the Traditional Chinese a 16x16 bitmap set, both drawn for this header, and the SVGs are built by a plain Node script.

| on screen | reads | means |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 一座小島，一棵椰子樹，十個小時。 | yí zuò xiǎo dǎo, yì kē yēzi shù, shí ge xiǎoshí | one small island, one coconut palm, ten hours |
| 一棵椰子樹 | yì kē yēzi shù | One Coconut Palm, the (invented) station |
| [公告] | gōnggào | announcement |
| ※ 發信站 ... 來自: 樹頂 | fāxìn zhàn ... láizì: shù dǐng | posted from ... from: the treetop (where the one bar of signal is) |
| 每天都是晴天 | měitiān dōu shì qíngtiān | every day is a sunny day |
| 線上1人, 我是lowbun | xiànshàng yì rén, wǒ shì lowbun | 1 user online; I am lowbun |
| 日常, 排程, 島上, 音樂, 畫面, 天氣 | | everyday, schedule, on the island, music, picture, weather (the board classes) |

The style is an unofficial homage to that board culture and is not affiliated with any real board or station. Castaway is an unofficial remake inspired by the 1992 screensaver *Johnny Castaway*, which belongs to its owners.

</details>
